blocks.text: Returning to the Louvre for a second visit, I finally had time to wander beyond the Mona Lisa and explore the Denon and Sully wings, home to the Venus de Milo and vast collections of Egyptian antiquities.
Once a medieval fortress and later a royal palace, the building itself is a work of art, with the Cour Carree courtyard offering a quieter contrast to the crowds around Pei's glass pyramid.
